title: The waiting page gets its final look, in every repo at once
why: Your worry, Oct 26: "is it already too late to decide the look ... I realize i allowed a beta to be the final product". It is not too late: every repo's page comes from one template, skills/waiting-page/page.html.
note: Final design (version 13): https://claude.ai/artifact/2DodmME3zxVTmi26B3KzBR, source plans/waiting-mockups/final-combined.html, with the template change list in its Design notes. shiv approved the look Oct 27 01:01 CDT ("looks pretty good", cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2RuC7HdpGEa99YN7j3ztLUk). It holds: one stable list in three tiers (Blocking, Upcoming, Whenever) derived from holds and by fields; related items in one frame with one sentence; a slim 44px repo-colour header, contrast-checked, with a colour drawn from the name when a repo has none (c105); state colours turned away from the repo hue; nothing preselected, my pick starred, Take my pick in one tap, one Send with a stamp and Undo (closes c74); a receipts trail that needs c99; a left overview in plain words (progress, ready count, each tier with its numbers), no symbol key; labels shown once (c106); Designs tab with inline mockups in a sheet (c112); a last "Pick stands" section for questions that change no rule, where my pick goes unless changed (shiv, Oct 27 02:27 CDT). Next: a build lane on skills/waiting-page. Port: yes, through the skill.
